extractors.name: timeframe_states_payload
extractors.semantics: Expose only explicitly enumerated scalar numeric/enum leaf fields after schema census; no whole-payload embedding.

extractors.name: atr_1d
extractors.semantics: Read the native 1d ATR field only; no ATR recomputation from future or external data.
extractors.source_authority: profile.timeframe_states['1d'] native ATR scalar if present

extractors.name: atr_normalized
extractors.semantics: ATR/reference_price using values available at the replay as_of only.
extractors.source_authority: same-as-of F020 divided by same-as-of reference close

extractors.name: nearest_support_distance_pct
extractors.semantics: Nearest support by absolute price distance; signed as (support-reference)/reference.

extractors.name: nearest_resistance_distance_pct
extractors.semantics: Nearest resistance by absolute price distance; signed as (resistance-reference)/reference.

extractors.name: institutional_volume_state
extractors.semantics: Schema census then scalar field whitelist only; no free-form/opaque payload encoding.

extractors.name: relative_strength_vs_spy_proxy
extractors.semantics: Two scalar features later: trailing 13w and 26w symbol return minus SPY return, using only sessions <= as_of.
extractors.source_authority: frozen symbol daily prefix + frozen SPY daily prefix

extractors.name: relative_strength_vs_sector
extractors.semantics: Must remain unavailable until historical point-in-time sector membership and benchmark authority is certified.

extractors.name: symbol_drawdown_from_52w_peak
extractors.semantics: close_asof/max(close over prior 252 available sessions inclusive)-1.

extractors.name: distance_from_52w_low
extractors.semantics: close_asof/min(close over prior 252 available sessions inclusive)-1.

targets.formula: symbol_forward_return - SPY_forward_return over same session horizon
targets.name: market_relative_forward_return

targets.formula: UP if absolute_forward_return>0; DOWN if <0; ZERO if ==0
targets.name: direction_label
